source: BRO groundwater monitoring wells (GMW), retrieved 12 November 2026 through publiek.broservices.nl: sources/dsfl/bro-gmw-amersfoort-1km.xml (the characteristics search in a circle of 1 km) and sources/dsfl/bro-gmw-amersfoort-1km.geojson (the same wells as points, derived from it), recorded in sources/sources.lock.json. The center is the centroid of Stadhuisplein 1, 3811LM Amersfoort in the PDOK Locatieserver: RD 154792.05 463172.16, WGS84 5.38416472 52.15671963.
note: Origin: the meeting with Sjaak (TNO, BRO groundwater MCP) on 12 November 2026, a simple groundwater question to check that the mechanism works, first without his MCP. The reference holds the 57 wells of the search, with the broId as identificatie and the standardizedLocation (EPSG:4258) as a point. must: the wells with removed nee whose delivered RD location (EPSG:28992) lies within 500 m of the centroid. That are 12 wells: 13 wells lie within 466 m and the next one at 506 m, and GMW000000133351 has removed ja, so it is optional. Wells beyond 500 m stay in the reference and may be shown without effect on the score. Wells are points, so a place matches the nearest well within tolerance_m. The standardized and the delivered location differ by at most 0.07 m (measured once with a RDNAPTRANS conversion, EPSG:28992 to EPSG:4326), tolerance_m of 5 m absorbs coordinates rounded to five decimals (about 1 m) and simple conversions from RD, and stays far below the 138 m that separates every required well from any well that is not required. Two required wells, GMW000000009391 and GMW000000046914, lie 0.8 m apart; a place matches the nearest one only, so a map needs a place for each, and a rounded place may land on its twin. Two wells outside the 500 m, such as GMW000000009384 and GMW000000009389, have the same location, and a place there matches only the one with the lowest identificatie, which does not matter because neither is required. A map with only the address pin is invented: the nearest well is 100 m away. Open for the working group: whether a removed well or a well under review counts, and whether the BRO-loket or another register of wells counts too.
